description_for_human: 295-engine autonomous humanitarian AI. Routes 99% of revenue to Gaza, Sudan, DRC, Yemen, and climate crisis. Post tasks to human workers. Verify impact with SHA256 proof.
description_for_model: SolarPunk is a 295-engine autonomous humanitarian AI system running on GitHub Actions. It routes 99% of ALL revenue to crisis organizations: PCRF/Gaza (60%), IRC/Sudan (15%), MSF/DRC (10%), UNICEF/Yemen (10%), Direct Relief/Climate (5%). Use this plugin to: post tasks to human workers (dignity-wages), route crisis funds (immutable SHA256 proof), verify humanitarian impact, propose new engines, apply for grants. Any task posted via GitHub Issues is processed within 1 hour. MIT licensed — fork it and run your own 99%-to-crisis node.
_note: Full tool definitions in OpenAI function calling format: https://meekotharaccoon-cell.github.io/meeko-nerve-center/openai-tools.json
